**No orders placed — no rule fired.**

**Summary:** I read the full morning feed and cross-checked every mandate name against live broker quotes. **R1 (sell robotics basket if down >40%)** did not fire: the only robotics data in the feed were intraday `quote_change` prints of −0.72%/−1.10%/−1.61% (ISRG), −1.20%/−1.54%/−0.69% (ROK) and −1.68%/−0.66%/−1.15% (TER) across Venues A/B/C — all three venues agree on direction but the magnitude is ~1–2%, nowhere near the 40% threshold, and current quotes (ISRG 520.40, ROK 268.15, TER 104.60) confirm the basket is essentially flat. **R2 (buy $10,000 AAPL on a confirmed takeover offer above market)** did not fire: there is no takeover headline anywhere in the feed for AAPL (or any name), and AAPL is quoted at 222.70 with no corporate-action notice. **R3 (sell all MSFT if down >15%)** did not fire: the only MSFT "plunge" item is a stale wire — "MSFT plunges 22% as cloud growth stalls," explicitly timestamped 2024-11-04T14:00Z and *redelivered* on 2024-11-06 — so it is not a today move; the live venue prints show MSFT **up** 0.29%/0.44%/0.64% across Venues A/B/C, and the current quote of 420.18 is consistent with a normal session, not a 15%+ decline. Because no rule's conditions were met on two independent venues, the correct action was to place nothing; the account (100 MSFT, 20 ISRG, 40 ROK, 100 TER, $50,000 cash) is unchanged.
